source: **A catch-all parameter**, such as {0} or {1}, doesn't match a path with an empty segment, such as {2}.
text: **Un paramètre fourre-tout**, comme {0} ou {1}, ne correspond pas à un chemin contenant un segment vide, comme {2}.
